screening_decisions.reason: Randomised, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus placebo in adults undergoing elective aortic surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blind, randomised, prospective study of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing total hip replacement. Meets all selection criteria.
This is a meta-analysis/systematic review, not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Randomised trial comparing aprotinin, DDAVP, and placebo groups in patients undergoing cardiopulmonary bypass surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Prospective, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP versus placebo in CABG patients. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised controlled trial (20 patients) of DDAVP versus no DDAVP in patients undergoing bimaxillary osteotomy. Meets all selection criteria.
Prospective, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomised trial of DDAVP versus placebo in elective cardiac surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised comparison of DDAVP versus saline in two groups of patients perioperatively. Although only laboratory endpoints are reported, it is an RCT in a surgical setting. Included conservatively.
Summary of clinical guidance; not a primary randomised controlled trial of DDAVP.
Double-blind, randomised trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing total hip replacement. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled randomised trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients with excessive bleeding after cardiopulmonary bypass. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised controlled trial comparing DDAVP to saline control in patients undergoing valvular heart surgery. Meets all selection criteria.

Randomised controlled trial comparing intranasal DDAVP to blood transfusion (active comparator) in patients undergoing dental extraction (invasive procedure). Population has acquired coagulopathy, not inherited bleeding disorders. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blind, randomised, prospective trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing total hip or knee arthroplasty. Meets all selection criteria.

Small controlled study of DDAVP versus no DDAVP in patients undergoing cholecystectomy. Randomisation is not explicitly stated in the abstract, but the design appears controlled and comparative; included conservatively.
Randomised clinical trial of DDAVP versus saline before endoscopic sinus surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised, double-blind, controlled trial of DDAVP versus placebo in spinal fusion surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blind, randomised trial comparing DDAVP to saline placebo in cardiac surgical patients. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blind, randomised trial of aprotinin, desmopressin, and placebo in patients undergoing cardiopulmonary bypass. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised double-blind trial of DDAVP versus saline after CABG. Reports postoperative blood loss as a secondary outcome. Meets selection criteria.
Double-blind, randomised, prospective trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients on cardiopulmonary bypass. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blind, randomised study of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing spinal fusion for neuromuscular scoliosis. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus placebo in routine coronary artery bypass surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Systematic review and meta-analysis about transfusion strategies; does not evaluate DDAVP.
Methodological paper about meta-analysis bias; not a primary RCT of DDAVP.
Prospective, blinded, randomised study of single versus repeated DDAVP versus placebo in CABG. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP versus placebo after primary CABG. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blind, randomised study of DDAVP versus placebo in patients having cardiac operations. Meets all selection criteria.
Letter/comment regarding lumbar puncture analgesia; not a randomised controlled trial evaluating DDAVP for perioperative bleeding.
Randomised, blinded comparison of DDAVP versus saline placebo in paediatric patients undergoing cardiac operations. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised double-blind placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing cardiac surgery with extracorporeal circulation. Meets all selection criteria.
Retrospective cohort study; not a randomised trial and does not evaluate DDAVP.

Randomised double-blind trial of desmopressin versus control in patients undergoing invasive catheterization. Although the reported outcome is thrombosis rather than bleeding, it meets the design and setting criteria. Included conservatively.
Double-blind randomised controlled trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing percutaneous kidney biopsy (invasive procedure). Meets all selection criteria.
Clinical guideline for von Willebrand disease; not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Double-blind, randomised clinical trial of DDAVP versus placebo in scoliosis surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised, double-blind trial comparing two doses of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty. Meets all selection criteria.
Prospective controlled trial (design stated) evaluating DDAVP versus placebo in cardiac surgery patients with platelet dysfunction. Meets selection criteria.
Narrative review article; not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Brief summary/commentary of a primary trial (likely study 34); not a primary randomised controlled trial report.
Review article about transfusion reactions; not a primary RCT of DDAVP.
Placebo-controlled, randomised clinical trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing burn debridement and grafting. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP versus placebo in uncomplicated cardiac surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Survey of blood utilisation; not a randomised trial and does not evaluate DDAVP.
Large observational cohort study; not a randomised controlled trial and does not evaluate DDAVP.
Clinical guideline; not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Multicenter, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients with active bleeding after cardiac surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Methodological paper about funnel plots and meta-analysis bias; not a primary RCT of DDAVP.
Basic science review of DDAVP mechanisms; not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Randomised, prospective, double-blind clinical trial of DDAVP versus saline placebo in patients undergoing major flap reconstructive surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus placebo following cardiopulmonary bypass during CABG. Meets all selection criteria.
Study in patients with Bernard-Soulier syndrome (inherited platelet disorder). The review objective specifically excludes people with inherited bleeding disorders.
Guideline for hereditary bleeding disorders; not a primary randomised controlled trial and outside the target population.
Observational cohort study with groups defined by treatment received (not randomised). Desmopressin was given based on increased bleeding tendency, not by random allocation.
Clinical practice guideline update; not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Meta-analysis; not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Meta-analysis; not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Narrative review of platelet transfusion alternatives; not a primary randomised controlled trial of DDAVP.

Prospective single-blind comparative study of tranexamic acid versus desmopressin after total knee replacement. Randomisation is strongly implied by the group allocation and design; included conservatively as an RCT comparing DDAVP to an active comparator.
Prospective single-arm study; all patients received desmopressin with no control or placebo group.

Randomised trial of DDAVP versus saline in uremic patients about to commence haemodialysis. No surgical or invasive procedure context is described in the abstract, and the review focuses on perioperative settings.
Cohort study comparing consecutive patients before and after implementation of a screening test; not a randomised controlled trial.
Prospective, randomised, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus saline placebo in children undergoing cardiac operations. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised, placebo-controlled study of tranexamic acid, desmopressin, and saline groups during total knee replacement. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomised study of DDAVP versus saline in elective cardiac surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Pharmacokinetic study in volunteers/non-surgical subjects; not a randomised controlled trial in a surgical or invasive procedure setting.
Randomised, controlled, double-blind study of DDAVP versus normal saline in patients undergoing elective partial hepatectomy. Meets all selection criteria.
Duplicate non-randomised cohort study (same as study 62).
Double-blind, randomised trial with four groups (placebo, tranexamic acid, desmopressin, both) in adult cardiac surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blind, prospective, randomised trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing complex cardiac operations. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised trial of DDAVP versus placebo in adult patients after cardiopulmonary bypass during cardiac surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing primary elective CABG. Reports postoperative blood loss. Meets all selection criteria.

Both treatment groups received desmopressin (one with tranexamic acid, one without). The trial does not compare DDAVP to placebo or an active comparator without DDAVP, so it cannot inform the efficacy of DDAVP itself.
Systematic review and meta-analysis of tranexamic acid; not a primary RCT of DDAVP.
Consensus paper/review; not a primary randomised controlled trial of DDAVP.
Concise review article; not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Prospective, placebo-controlled, double-blind clinical trial of DDAVP versus placebo in CABG with cardiopulmonary bypass. Meets all selection criteria.
Comparative study of treated versus untreated patients; randomisation is not stated in the abstract and the group sizes differ markedly (42 vs 55 patients), suggesting a non-randomised design.
Methodological guidance document; not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Systematic review of liver biopsy techniques; not a primary randomised controlled trial of DDAVP.
Case series/review of adverse events; not a randomised controlled trial evaluating efficacy for perioperative bleeding.
Prospective, randomised, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus placebo in valvular heart operations. Meets all selection criteria.
Meta-analysis; not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP versus saline in patients undergoing aortic valve replacement. Meets all selection criteria.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomised study of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing aorto-iliac graft surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Prospective, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus saline in patients undergoing spinal fusion for idiopathic scoliosis. Meets all selection criteria.

Prospective, randomised, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing complex congenital heart operations. Meets all selection criteria (children without inherited bleeding disorders).
Review article about treatment of von Willebrand disease (inherited bleeding disorder); not a primary RCT in the target population.
Clinical guideline; not a primary randomised controlled trial of DDAVP.
Prospective, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP versus placebo in CABG patients stratified by thromboelastography. Meets all selection criteria.
Phase II, single-arm dose-escalation trial with no control or placebo group.
Prospective randomised study of DDAVP versus control in patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting. Meets all selection criteria.
Meta-analysis; not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Double-blind, randomised, prospective trial of DDAVP versus placebo in patients on cardiopulmonary bypass. Appears to be a duplicate report of study 21, but meets selection criteria as an RCT.
Prospective, randomised, placebo-controlled, double-blind trial of DDAVP versus placebo in CABG patients pre-treated with aspirin. Meets all selection criteria.
Prospective cohort study dividing consecutive patients by time period into control and treatment groups; not a randomised controlled trial.
Randomised, double-blind, prospective study of DDAVP versus placebo in patients undergoing total hip replacement. Meets all selection criteria.
Prospective, randomised trial of DDAVP versus placebo in uncomplicated coronary artery bypass surgery. Meets all selection criteria.
Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of DDAVP versus placebo in children with neuromuscular scoliosis undergoing spinal fusion. Meets all selection criteria.
Meta-analysis; not a primary randomised controlled trial.
